_comment: Curated game-name -> icon-image-URL overrides for the Library sidebar.
Fetched from GitHub raw at runtime (RemoteGameIconsService), cached locally and
refreshed at most once a day - so a game can be covered for everyone by editing
this file on master, with no release needed. Same mechanism as
Only needed for games GameIconService can't resolve automatically. It already
looks games up on the Steam store by name, so Steam titles (including small indie
ones) generally need no entry here. Add a game when it is either not on Steam at
all (Fortnite, Rocket League, Valorant, League of Legends) or when the Steam search
matches the wrong product - searching 'Overwatch 2' returns a seasonal starter-pack
DLC rather than the game, which the strict name check rejects, leaving it to this
Keys are matched case-insensitively against the game name shown on a clip.
Prefer a square-ish image; wide art gets centre-cropped into the round badge.
Anything unresolved falls back to the icon extracted from the running game's own
executable, and finally to a letter badge - so a missing entry is never fatal.
